_game: Baba Is AI: make_win, a generated puzzle in the style of Baba Is You (language / rule-manipulation puzzle)
_note: uv sync --extra baba (baba-gym, gym/baba/, pulls baba-is-ai from GitHub). Env ids: env/make_win, env/goto_win, env/you_win, and distractor variants. Push word blocks to rewrite the rules.
_keys_note: BabaIsYouEnv.Actions (baba/grid.py): 0=idle, 1=up, 2=right, 3=down, 4=left. Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
_menu_note: A puzzle can be pushed into a dead end, so after 15 s of play holding X for 5 s pauses the game and offers Restart / Give up / Resume (UP/DOWN to choose, SPACE to select). See fmri_gym/menu.py.
_curriculum_note: Blocking, as Baba Is You is: the block is this level played until won (mode 'episode', n_episodes 1, advancing_outcomes ['won']); a loss -- YOU destroyed or no YOU left -- restarts the same level, as the game itself does, and max_duration 300 s is the cap. The menu's Give up is the way out of a level the subject cannot solve.

text: Push word blocks to rewrite the rules.
Form "X IS WIN", then touch X to win.
hold X   pause menu (restart / give up / resume)
